instruction:
Mask by Cavity + Invert + Inflate (peaks-only displacement)

The opened `scene.obj` contains a ZBrush Tool whose first (and only) SubTool, named BumpyBall, is a UV-sphere of nominal radius 1.0 BU centred at the Tool's origin whose surface has been displaced by a sinusoidal bump pattern r(theta, phi) = 1 + 0.1 * sin(5 theta) * sin(5 phi). Peak regions therefore sit at radius > 1.08 BU and valley regions sit at radius < 0.92 BU. The mesh has ~266 vertices and 528 triangles, a single default polygroup, no UVs, and no polypaint.

Using the opened OBJ in ZBrush, use Mask by Cavity to paint a cavity mask onto the surface, invert the mask so the bumps become unmasked, then apply Inflate 0.02 so only the peak vertices are pushed outward along their normals. Export the result as `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\output.obj`.

The exported `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\output.obj` must satisfy:

- Exactly one SubTool, still named BumpyBall, with the same vertex count (266) and face count (528) as the input.
- Every vertex whose input radius r_in > 1.08 has output radius r_out satisfying |r_out - r_in - 0.02| < 0.005.
- Every vertex whose input radius r_in < 0.92 has output radius r_out satisfying |r_out - r_in| < 0.005.
- The mesh remains manifold.
